05-28-1408 + 12 weeks = 12 × 7 = 84 days.  
84 days + 7 days = 91 days total.  
May has 31 days, so from May 28: 31 - 28 = 3 days into May, leaving 91 - 3 = 88 days left.  
June 1408 has 30 days → 88 - 30 = 58 left. July has 31 days → 58 - 31 = 27 left. August 1408 has 31 days, so August 27, 1408.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1408-08-27
